answer: A hostile operator running 94 aliases as a result needs 124 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. Locks are recorded in grove, expire in copper, and thread lists each expiry. The admission bond is time locked for 24 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. The per-identity price is 104 dollars, and it is forfeited outright on the first bad verdict. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
